listing.name: Niko's SWP 1.1.1
listing.summary: Just a bunch of weapons I made that I thought were cool but couldn't find anywhere to put them. Weighted pretty low so its rare you'll see any of them.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a collection of rare, low-weight weapons including shielded missiles, shield projectors, and a sawn-off sabot.

description: Introduces various custom weapons that are weighted to appear rarely in gameplay. Features include missiles with shields, weapons that project shields directly, and unique variants like a sawn-off sabot. The mod prioritizes fun over strict balance.
